zelle_registry.description: REFERENCE ONLY — human-readable summary of Zelle people and their categories. The app does NOT read this file. All rules that affect the dashboard live in merchant_rules.json. This file exists so you and the agent can quickly review who is mapped to what without reading the full rulebook.

entertainment.description: Only classify Zelle as Entertainment if explicitly for fun: concert tickets, event booths, splitting a fun outing.

classification_rules.unknown_policy: Any Zelle recipient NOT in confirmed_people must be flagged as Unknown / Needs Review. Never auto-assign Entertainment to Zelle payments.
